description: Clips that leave nothing: an empty clip path, a clip outside the canvas, and a clip path whose only calls are dropped for NaN arguments hide their children; the siblings around them draw
toleranceNote: Every draw goes through ports of Chrome's own pipeline (Skia's analytic anti-aliasing, edge builder and clipper, stroker, dasher and AntiFillRect, Blink's arc handling), so what remains is rounding in blending, coverage and sampling: against Chrome 153 no pixel here is more than 0 levels off. 8 leaves room for another Chrome build that rounds differently.
